title: Coverage layer (beta)
desc: Select a point on the map or enter a node name to calculate radio coverage in every direction based on the terrain and a simplified link budget (ERP, free-space path loss, receiver sensitivity). The model does not account for diffraction or signal attenuation caused by forests and buildings.
terrainMarginDesc: An obstacle blocks the line of sight only if it rises above it by more than this value. This tolerance reduces the effect of noise in the elevation model (30 m grid), which could otherwise incorrectly indicate a lack of coverage at low antenna heights.
erpDesc: Effective radiated power of the transmitter (including antenna gain). Limits range independently of terrain, via free-space path loss and receiver sensitivity, with a 10 dB fade margin.
linkBudgetRange: Link budget range (ERP): {{range}} - the same in every direction
fetchElevationFailed: Failed to fetch elevation data. Please try again.
